title: Beyond Retraining-Free MoE Compression: A Cost-Normalized Study of Post-Compression Adjustment
abstract: arXiv:2609.06076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retraining-free MoE compression reduces deployment memory by pruning or merging experts, but often treats the compressed checkpoint as the final artifact. We argue that this view is incomplete: compressed MoE checkpoints are better understood as compressed initializations that benefit from a tiny post-compression adjustment stage. Across two MoE LLM backbones, four pruning/merging methods, three expert-retention ratios, and 28 benchmarks, we compare LM fine-tuning and teacher-based KD under matched small-data budgets and measured GPU costs. Using only 3,000 C4 examples and a single epoch of adjustment, Full FT recovers 37.3% of the original-to-compressed performance gap on average. Moreover, LM fine-tuning is more cost-effective than standard token-level KD, and full-parameter adjustment gives the strongest cost--recovery trade-off among the tested scopes. translated_title: 超越免再训练MoE压缩：后压缩调整的成本归一化研究
translated_abstract: 免再训练的MoE（混合专家）压缩通过剪枝或合并专家来减少部署内存，但通常将压缩后的检查点视为最终产物。我们认为这种观点是不完整的：压缩后的MoE检查点更适合被理解为压缩后的初始化状态，它们可以从一个微小的压缩后调整阶段中受益。在两个MoE大语言模型骨干网络、四种剪枝/合并方法、三种专家保留比例以及28个基准测试上，我们在匹配的小数据预算和实测GPU成本下，比较了语言模型微调与基于教师的知识蒸馏。仅使用3,000条C4样本和单个epoch的调整，全量微调平均可以恢复原始模型与压缩模型之间性能差距的37.3%。此外，语言模型微调比标准的token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益，并且在测试的调整范围中，全参数调整展现出最强的成本-性能恢复权衡。这些结果表明，免再训练压缩应该与小的（压缩后调整）相结合。
tldr: 压缩后的MoE模型应被视为“压缩初始化”而非最终产物：仅需3,000条样本、单个epoch的低成本后压缩调整（尤其是全参数微调），即可平均恢复压缩造成的37.3%的性能损失，且比token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益。
en_tdlr: Compressed MoE checkpoints should be treated as "compressed initializations" rather than final artifacts: a tiny post-compression adjustment (especially full-parameter fine-tuning) using just 3,000 examples and one epoch recovers 37.3% of the compression-induced performance gap on average, and is more cost-effective than token-level KD.
